routine.title: Speed + COD — Quick
routine.notes: Reduced version for a week/day with extra football load. Keep quality high and leave fresh. Skip entirely if the football session itself already provides hard sprint/COD exposure.

exercises.notes: 4 x 15-20 m. Fast, relaxed, full recovery.
Controlled braking. 2 reps each side/lead pattern.
Planned cuts only. 2 each side. Stop while movement quality is high.
